jobs.title: Business Development / BDR (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unterstütze uns im Business Development als BDR (m/w/d) bei Carwow

UNSERE MISSION

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt. Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang.

DEINE MISSION

Du treibst das Wachstum von Carwow voran, indem du unabhängige Händler und Händlergruppen gewinnst und erfolgreich an Board holst. Mit beratungsorientiertem Verkauf, gezielten Demos und viel Telefonpower sorgst du für Carwow Begeisterung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Account-Management zusammen, um langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Gewinnung neuer Händler und Aktivierung auf der Sell-my-Car-Plattform (Gebote & Käufe).

  • Neukundengewinnung durch Kaltakquise und Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads – primär telefonisch, bei Bedarf auch durch Vor-Ort-Termine.

  • Identifikation und Entwicklung von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen (z. B. Transport, Wallet, Finanzierungen und weitere Services).

  • Aufbau nachhaltiger Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Händlern aller Größenordnungen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Account-Management für eine reibungslose Übergabe und Reaktivierung inaktiver Händler.

  • Durchführung überzeugender Pitches – vom Geschäftsführer bis zum Einzelunternehmer.

  • Pflege und Dokumentation aller Aktivitäten im CRM (z. B. Salesforce).

DEIN PROFIL

Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

  • Erfahrung im Automotive Retail / Autohandel oder vergleichbaren Business-Development-Rollen.

  • Hunter-Mentalität: Freude am Prospecting, an Akquise und am Aufbau neuer Partnerschaften.

  • Kommunikations- und Verhandlungssicherheit, gepaart mit nachweislicher Sales-Erfahrung.

  • Analytisches Denken: Fähigkeit, Daten zu nutzen, um Chancen und Risiken zu erkennen.

  • Sicheres Auftreten in Präsentationen – mit Anpassungsfähigkeit an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. Salesforce).

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, hohe Eigenmotivation und Belastbarkeit in einem dynamischen Scale-up.

UNSER BEWERBUNGSPROZESS

In der Regel kannst du etwa mit zwei bis drei Wochen für den Bewerbungsprozess rechnen.

  • Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten

  • Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • 28 Urlaubstage + Feiertage (steigend bis 35 Tage mit Betriebszugehörigkeit), zusätzliche freie Tage für Umzug, Hochzeit u. v. m.

  • Monatliches Coaching & Mental-Health-Support (Spill)

  • „Work from abroad“-Programm (1 Monat/Jahr)

  • Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget

  • 500 € Home-Office-Budget

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind fest in unserer Unternehmenskultur verankert. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und treffen unsere Entscheidungen fair, transparent und ausschließlich auf Basis von Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Potenzial.

jobs.description:
Intro

Do you enjoy turning marketing ideas into effective, automated customer journeys?

We’re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist (m/f/d) to strengthen our Marketing team in Hannover. In this role, you’ll focus on email marketing and marketing automation – building campaigns, creating targeted audiences, developing automated workflows, and using performance insights to continuously improve our communications.

You’ll work closely with regional Marketing, Content, Design and Sales teams in an international environment and help us deliver relevant communications throughout the customer lifecycle.

Your Job

  • Plan, build, test and optimize email campaigns, newsletters and automated marketing workflows in HubSpot.

  • Create relevant audience segments based on customer data, behavior and lifecycle stages.

  • Build and improve automated journeys such as nurture, follow-up, re-engagement and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Use personalization and dynamic content to make communications more relevant to different audiences.

  • Monitor campaign performance and turn key metrics and A/B test results into practical improvements.

  • Ensure campaigns are thoroughly tested before launch, including links, tracking, personalization, segmentation and responsive display.

  • Collaborate with Content, Design, Regional Marketing and Sales teams to deliver effective campaigns.

  • Help maintain clean and reliable marketing data and support the connection between HubSpot, Salesforce and our website.

  • Follow email marketing best practices around consent, data protection and deliverability.

Your Profile

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in marketing automation, email marketing, CRM marketing or a similar digital marketing role.

  • Practical experience working with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform; strong HubSpot experience is a plus.

  • Experience creating email campaigns, automated workflows, audience segments and customer journeys.

  • A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to improve future campaigns.

  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to campaign testing and quality assurance.

  • Comfortable working with CRM data and collaborating with Marketing and Sales stakeholders.

  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email adjustments is helpful, but you don’t need to be a developer.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence working in an international, collaborative environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Salesforce alongside a marketing automation platform.

  • Experience in an international or B2B marketing environment.

  • Familiarity with more advanced HubSpot functionality, integrations or reporting.

Your Benefits

  • Be part of a growing global company in one of the most dynamic industries — cybersecurity.

  • Short decision paths and flat hierarchies in an open working atmosphere.

  • Personal and professional development opportunities.

  • Home-office option and flexible, trust-based working time.

  • Be-Active Bonus — allowance for membership in fitness and sports clubs.

  • Whether by car, public transport, or bike – we make your commute easier with free parking (Hannover), a discounted Jobticket, or bike leasing.

  • Employer contribution to the company pension plan.

  • Unlimited contracts — we’re looking for hornets to grow long-term with us.

  • Temporary Employee Exchange Program – opportunity to work at our global office locations (e.g. Malta, Madrid, Montréal, Washington D.C.).

  • Referral Bonus: €1,500 for every successful candidate referral.

  • Team events like laser tag, an escape room, or a get-together at our own legendary beer truck in Hanover – let yourself be surprised!

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
Für Deutschlands größtes unabhängiges Homecare-Unternehmen aus Ahrensburg bei Hamburg suche ich einen Salesforce Developer, der die Plattform-Entwicklung nach innen holt. Salesforce ist dort der operative Steuerungspunkt für Vertrieb und Service, angebunden an SAP und weitere Kernsysteme. Der Code entsteht heute überwiegend bei externen Entwicklern. Genau das änderst du: Als interner Salesforce Developer wirst du zum Maschinenraum der Plattform und baust das Know-how auf, das bisher eingekauft wurde.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Apex & LWC: Du entwickelst eigenständig in Apex und Lightning Web Components und testest, deployst und dokumentierst deine Lösungen selbst.

  • Schnittstellen & KI: Du bereitest Salesforce für APIs und KI-Anwendungen vor, etwa für Integrationen oder einen geplanten Telefon-Bot im Kundenservice.

  • Architektur & Reviews: Du arbeitest an Solution Designs mit, führst Code-, Design- und Architektur-Reviews durch und etablierst Best Practices im Team.

  • Know-how nach innen: Du arbeitest eng mit der Teamleitung und externen Entwicklern zusammen und holst die Projektarbeit Schritt für Schritt nach innen.

Dein Profil

  • Salesforce-Entwicklung: Du bringst rund drei Jahre intensive Erfahrung in Apex, LWC und komplexen Flows inklusive APIs mit und erklärst die Komplexität an eigenen Projekten.

  • DevOps & Release: Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im DevOps- und Release-Management mit, vor allem im Pipeline-Management, und hast erste Kenntnisse in Security & Sharing.

  • ITSM-Verständnis: Du kennst Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management und lässt ein Projekt auch mal liegen, wenn ein Major Incident das Business blockiert. Eine ITIL-Zertifizierung brauchst du nicht.

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest pragmatisch mit Kollegen und externen Partnern und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, der Arbeitssprache im Team. Zertifizierungen wie Platform Developer sind ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung.

Das erwartet dich

  • Plattform statt Projekt: eine neu geschaffene Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, Mitsprache bei Architektur und Projekten vom Telefon-Bot bis zur KI-Roadmap.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine flexible Remote-Regelung (2-3 Tage die Woche; individuelle Regelungen sind denkbar)

  • Dazu Hardware nach Wahl bis hin zum Mac und KI-Coding-Tools im Rahmen der europäischen Datenvorgaben.

  • Team mit Humor: ein harmonisches Team, das sich trotz vollem Kalender Zeit füreinander nimmt, bis zur gemeinsamen Mittagspause im Büro.

  • Konditionen & Benefits: ein faires Vergütungspaket in unbefristeter Festanstellung, dazu 30 Tage Urlaub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss, Urban Sports, Business Bike Leasing, Corporate Benefits und der hauseigene Weiterbildungs-Campus.

jobs.title: Client Sales Director (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Client Sales Director to lead one of our Client Enterprise Sales teams in Germany. You will manage and develop a senior team of Sales Managers, providing coaching and mentorship, shaping deal strategy, supporting high-stakes negotiations, and designing complex commercial initiatives. You'll build strategic partnerships with enterprise prospects, leading consultative sales cycles and crafting solutions tailored to their specific challenges.

Beyond team leadership, you'll act as a cross-functional connector, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to ensure strategic alignment, remove roadblocks, and accelerate outcomes.

This is more than a job. It's a high-impact opportunity for professional and financial growth, with competitive, performance-based compensation. It's ideal for collaborative, entrepreneurial leaders who thrive in dynamic environments and value long-term customer relationships.

 

YOUR IMPACT

  • Enterprise Deal Execution & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS sales cycles, building data-driven ROI business cases, and consistently closing six-figure enterprise contracts.
  • Pipeline Generation & Regional Territory Health: Demonstrates proactive outbound prospecting, tight collaboration with SDR partners, and rigorous pipeline inspection to maintain high forecasting accuracy and predictable revenue growth.
  • Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Commands high-level conversations with C-suite and senior HR/Total Rewards leaders, establishing credibility, handling objections effectively, and building lasting strategic partnerships.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Effectively aligns cross-functional internal resources—including onboarding, legal, and product teams—to ensure seamless deal execution and post-sale client success.
  • Product Mastery & Solution-Selling: Articulates Wellhub's market value proposition clearly, translating product capabilities and case studies into bespoke executive solutions tailored to enterprise pain points.
  • Industry Representation & Network Expansion: Actively expands Wellhub's regional footprint and brand authority through targeted networking, industry event engagement, and relationship building within the HR community.
  • Mission Alignment & Culture Contribution: Exemplifies a commitment to workplace wellbeing, modeling sustainable high performance, collaborative empathy, and strong alignment with Wellhub's core mission.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading and coaching senior sales managers and high-performing SaaS teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, operational rigor, and consistent quota achievement.
  • Enterprise Revenue Growth: Track record of driving new business acquisition and closing high-value, complex deals, ideally within SaaS, HR consulting, or corporate benefits environments.
  • Executive Presence & Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional ability to build trusted relationships with C-level buyers, navigate intricate decision-making units, and align cross-functional partners to drive strategic outcomes.
  • Data-Driven Strategy & Pipeline Execution: Highly analytical approach to sales metrics and forecasting, leveraging CRM insights to optimize team performance, identify growth levers, and maintain predictability.
  • Persuasive Communication & Fluency: Professional business and technical English fluency, with strong acumen in delivering executive-level presentations, financial business cases, and consultative narratives.
  • Sales Tech & Modern Prospecting Acumen: High technical proficiency across modern sales stacks (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SalesLoft) to scale pipeline generation and streamline sales workflows.
  • Growth Mindset, Agility & Client Centricity: Proactive, outcome-oriented approach with a strong commitment to continuous learning, client advocacy, and navigating change in high-growth, fast-paced environments.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience leading senior sales teams, driving new business growth, and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

The Role

You'll be an engineer who builds AI agents in production, sitting close to the customers who depend on them.

This is a full-stack engineering job with an unusually short distance between your code and someone's actual workday. You'll write Go and Python, design schemas, build evals, and present your solution to a senior executive at an enterprise - often in the same week.

What You'll Do

  • Design and ship production agents. You'll build agents that are mission-critical from day one: embedded in Teams, Slack, intranets, voice lines, and email, taking real actions against SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and a long tail of systems nobody has heard of. These run at enterprise volume under enterprise scrutiny.

  • Own the full lifecycle. Discovery, build, eval, launch, and the unglamorous months afterward where an agent goes from good to genuinely reliable.

  • Work directly with the people whose problem it is. You'll sit with leaders at global enterprises, extract the process from their heads, and decide what should be an agent, what should be a workflow, and what should stay human.

  • Push your work back into the platform. The best patterns you find in the field become part of Ema's core product - new connectors, new agent primitives, new tooling. You'll surface unmet needs and prototype the fix, working with product and platform engineering to make it general.

Example Projects

Recent work by our engineers:

  • Built the orchestration layer for a 200,000+ employee IT services firm spanning 65 countries, unifying HR, IT, and payroll into a single interface across SAP, ServiceNow, and Teams.

  • Rebuilt a recruiting firm's core stack - sourcing, screening, ranked shortlists - cutting time-to-hire by 67% and retiring their legacy ATS along the way.

  • Cut first-response time from two hours to under 90 seconds for an e-commerce logistics platform, including live carrier-site lookups, and held SLAs through peak holiday volume with no temporary hiring.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems, with 5+ years of relevant engineering work

  • Strong backend fundamentals - algorithms, data modeling, and comfort in more than one language, Python and Go especially

  • Proven problem-solving in fast-changing, ambiguous environments where the requirements arrive in a meeting rather than a ticket

  • A builder's mindset and high agency - you find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear

  • Comfort working directly with customers

  • Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike

Even Better

  • You've built or deployed LLM systems in production, and have opinions about evals

  • Familiarity with agent tooling, RAG pipelines, MCP, and prompt engineering as an engineering discipline rather than a trick

  • You've been a founder or founding engineer, and know how to balance craft against speed

  • Experience integrating enterprise applications - HRIS, ITSM, ERP, ticketing - and the authentication that guards them

  • You've worked with distributed, global teams and multi-tenant SaaS environments

Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

Capital Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋


Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

At Lightspeed Commerce, we believe exceptional teams are built from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that members of underrepresented communities often apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If you are excited about this role and feel you can make an impact (even if your experience does not align perfectly with every bullet point), we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Manager, Capital based in Amsterdam to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you will partner directly with a dedicated portfolio of hospitality merchants, acting as a trusted advisor to help them scale and streamline their operations using Lightspeed Capital.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Merchant Growth: Partner with hospitality merchants across your portfolio to understand their financial needs and present Lightspeed Capital solutions effectively.

  • Build Strategic Relationships: Serve as a trusted consultative partner, identifying financing opportunities that align with your merchants' long-term business goals.

  • Manage Deal Cycles: Lead discussions, negotiate agreements, and close financial contracts to support portfolio retention and growth.

  • Collaborate for Territory Success: Work closely with regional leadership to identify expansion opportunities and meet regional goals.

What You Bring

  • B2B Account Management or Sales Experience: Proven experience managing client relationships, driving pipeline, and closing agreements. Fintech, SaaS, or financial services experience is a strong asset, but transferable consultative sales experience is welcome.

  • Consultative Communication: Ability to articulate financial concepts clearly and build rapport with merchant owners and executive stakeholders.

  • Growth Mindset: Comfort working in a fast-paced environment, taking initiative, and incorporating feedback to develop your craft.

  • Bilingual Fluency: Fluent professional proficiency in both Dutch and English (written and verbal).

Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with the hospitality or restaurant industry.

  • Exposure to SaaS, payments, or banking/lending products.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce.

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Uncapped commission

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

  • Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office

  • Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.
